@holistis on the limit you name (shape, not bytes): the bytes half already has a draft in x402, `response-provenance` (#3304, open): `responseHash = sha256(jcs({endpoint, inputs, result, method, dataVintage}))`, re-derivable offline by the buyer. One condition from the draft's own scope paragraph: the hash proves the response is *unaltered* only when it is bound inside a signed receipt (e.g. `offer-and-receipt`); on an unsigned response it proves reproducibility, and a bare extension block can be stripped or forged. That ties it to the signed-offer adoption you measured (0.04%).
